text: Yes, I've been smoking for a long time, and I work as a mechanic where I'm often surrounded with dust. speaker: Doctor
text:
That combination of heavy smoking, occupational dust exposure, and new ankle swelling is concerning for right-sided heart failure potentially caused by lung disease. Have you noticed any unusual fatigue or inability to lie flat without waking up gasping?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray (already performed, but I need to confirm if you have any history of pulmonary edema or specific heart murmurs noted in past records). Since we have limited tools, does your ankle swelling worsen after standing all day and improve with rest?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with secondary Cor Pulmonale (Right Heart Failure).
